title: Hard to figure out how to size it properly and use it
text:
Hard to figure out how to size it properly and use it. It’s tricky to know the sizing and how to use it. I bought mine from Warehouse and they came without instructions or video.
To humans it looks like a torture device though I know it’s not. These are recommended by lots of trainers but I think you need a Trainer to demo the thing for you.
